items.title: Skift Global Forum East: Five Decisions in the Room
items.summary: The most ambitious growth story in global tourism is being tested on every front as multiple wars fester throughout the Middle East. Every decision travel executives make today has to consider the long-term impact when these conflicts resolve.

items.title: Without a COP31 Deal, Destinations Have a Weaker Signal for Climate Resilience
items.summary: A failed decision at COP31 doesn’t stop tourism being able to take action on the ground. Without a guiding goal, destinations risk losing a long-term investment signal and political backstop for climate resilience and adaptation.

items.title: Hyatt Is ‘Sharpening’ Its Brands So AI Can Tell Them Apart

items.title: Why Big Investors Are Buying Europe’s Holiday Parks

items.title: AirAsia’s Q3 Shows Why Fernandes Pushed the Comeback to 2028
items.summary: AirAsia has shown it can charge more. It hasn't shown it can make money at its new, smaller size. Until the $1 billion debt financing lands, the balance sheet, not demand, decides when the comeback starts.
